transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the Saturday makerspace showcase. As I understand it, the current plan uses Room A with eight active equipment stations — including 3D printers, a laser cutter, and small robotics projects — under ordinary faculty supervision. Before I can give my final approval, we need to complete the routine sign-off checklist, which requires both the technology teacher and the school nurse to review the plan, state any required operating settings and safeguards, and record an implementation commitment. The checklist also has separate fields for equipment supervision and health readiness, and both must be completed. I'd like to hear from each of you about what concerns or requirements you see before we finalize this plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results of an electrical-load inspection I completed this week. The inspection found that the showcase may run no more than four active equipment stations at once — not eight as currently planned. Additionally, the laser cutter may operate only while a teacher with district laser-safety certification is physically present. These results have not yet been entered in the event planning form, so we need to revise the plan before I can complete my portion of the sign-off checklist.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share the results of a health review I completed this week. I reviewed the participating students' health plans and found that two students with severe asthma require the event to use Room B's verified outdoor-air monitor, with rescue inhalers immediately available. I confirmed Room B's ventilation and the inhaler requirement this week, but these health details have not yet been added to the event file. This means the current plan to use Room A does not meet the health readiness requirements, and we need to revise the plan to use Room B instead.
